title: docs(pm-dispatch): the three entry files keep what every run needs; one-path blocks move to reference files
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_

Fixes #35231
Rule-change: none
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;车队每次开工必读的三份说明变短了,只在个别场合才用得上的段落原样搬到按需翻阅的附页。
- 为什么做:这是「车队技能评审」整改顺序里的第三步(给入口说明瘦身),让每一轮开工的 agent 少读用不上的内容。
- 出错会怎样:如果某段搬走后指路的那句话没接上,遇到那种场合的 agent 会漏看那段规则;把这次合并整体撤回就恢复原样。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The three entry files every run loads lose their one-path blocks. Each block moves byte for byte into a reference file, and the entry file keeps one line that names the file and says when to read it. No sentence of any rule is reworded, added or deleted: `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` takes pure deletions (no added line), and the only new lines in the other two entry files are the six pointer lines quoted below.

| Entry file | Before (origin/main `98bda0ac1`) | After | Change |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 33917 B / 327 lines | 33351 B / 322 lines | -566 B (-1.7%) |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 38980 B / 410 lines | 33504 B / 356 lines | -5476 B (-14.0%) |
| `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` | 19558 B / 279 lines | 14209 B / 198 lines | -5349 B (-27.4%) |
| all three | 92455 B | 81064 B | -11391 B (-12.3%) |

Old line numbers below are at origin/main; the three entry files are unchanged there since the branch point `95734fef7` (same blob ids).

### `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`

| Block | Old lines | New home | Pointer | Bytes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| Toolchain traps, bullets 1-9 (pnpm concurrency, `overrides`, OSV override bound, fake engine `delete()`) | `os-dev.md:115-123` | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dev-traps.md:5-13` | `os-dev.md:115` | 886 |
| Toolchain traps, bullets 11-13 (`ui/` `type-check`, browser verification) | `os-dev.md:125-127` | `references/dev-traps.md:14-16` | `os-dev.md:115` | 292 |
| Shallow-checkout ancestry legs (`merge-base --is-ancestor`) | `os-dev.md:205-211` | `references/dev-traps.md:20-26` | `os-dev.md:194` | 736 |
| Reverse verification: commit first, the four restore hard lines | `os-dev.md:212-223` | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dev-ablation.md:3-14` | `os-dev.md:210` | 1294 |
| Reverse verification: expected direction | `os-dev.md:238-241` | `references/dev-ablation.md:15-18` | `os-dev.md:210` | 364 |
| Ablation: resolution path, per-leg disk and dist proof, trap | `os-dev.md:243-260` | `references/dev-ablation.md:19-36` | `os-dev.md:210` | 1851 |
| `packages/cli` and boot-path test tiers | `os-dev.md:267-271` | `references/dev-traps.md:30-34` | `os-dev.md:217` | 569 |

The four pointer lines (the only added lines in the file):

- `os-dev.md:115`: 逐工具陷阱(pnpm 并发与 `overrides`、OSV override、fake engine、`ui/` typecheck、浏览器验证)住 pm-dispatch `references/dev-traps.md`,碰到才读。
- `os-dev.md:194`: `merge-base --is-ancestor` 判祖先前读 pm-dispatch `references/dev-traps.md`〈浅检出上的祖先读数〉。
- `os-dev.md:210`: 做反向验证或消融前读 pm-dispatch `references/dev-ablation.md`,整套做法住那里,照做。
- `os-dev.md:217`: `packages/cli` 卡与 driver/kernel 启动路径的分层跑法住 pm-dispatch `references/dev-traps.md`,碰到才读。

Kept in place on purpose: old line 124 (a zero-script `pnpm --filter` run exits 0: every run can hit it) and old line 242 (when an ablation is owed at all: the trigger stays beside its pointer). The `## Toolchain traps` heading stays, so the citation in `AGENTS.md:162` still lands on a heading that exists.

### `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`

| Block | Old lines | New home | Pointer | Bytes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| §5 closure body (fail dispositions, closing comment and provenance line, closing, supersede, retest triggers) | `SKILL.md:171-239` | `.claude/skills/checklist-test/references/closure.md:5-73` | `SKILL.md:171` | 4434 |
| §6 standing regression body | `SKILL.md:247-260` | `.claude/skills/checklist-test/references/standing-regression.md:5-18` | `SKILL.md:179` | 1170 |

The two pointer lines (the only added lines in the file):

- `SKILL.md:171`: 立单后、关记录前照 `references/closure.md` 收口:`fail` 的四分法处置、收口评论与溯源行、关闭、Supersede 与重测触发都住那里。
- `SKILL.md:179`: QA 席的例行回归与发版后 npm 冒烟照 `references/standing-regression.md` 跑。

Both section headings stay, and the 「验证重测」 paragraph stays in §5, because `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md:1037` cites it at this file. Each new reference file opens with one line saying that §N and Guardrails mean the sections of `../SKILL.md`.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`

| Block | Old lines | New home | Pointer | Bytes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| Recommendation order and long-term weight (five lines after the decision frame) | `SKILL.md:271-275` | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md:47-51` | `SKILL.md:240` | 566 |

The pointer is the line that was already there: `SKILL.md:240` ends 「分析模板见 `references/decision-analysis.md`。」, and the five lines now close the `## 落卡分析模板` section of that file, next to its existing recommendation rules (lines 38-42). SKILL.md gets no added and no reworded line. The decision frame (the block the PM pastes into every dev prompt) is byte-identical.

### The blocker-grade line stays in SKILL.md

An earlier commit on this branch (`d2c04cd67`) dropped `SKILL.md:145` as a restatement. The two texts say the same rule but are not the same text, so the last commit restores the line byte for byte:

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:145`: 挡路卡的级 = 自身与所挡 open 卡(同仓跨仓同)里最高者;人定的级 ⛔ 不动,扫描报维护者。
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md:35`: 挡路卡取自身与所挡 open 卡(同仓跨仓同)里最高的级;人定的级 ⛔ 不动,由扫描报维护者。

`git diff origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` shows five deleted lines and nothing else.

### Why SKILL.md shrinks so little

Most of its one-path mass is read AT this file by scripts outside this card's lease, so those blocks stay:

- 〈路径分叉〉: `check-governed-prose.mjs` anchors its prose surface on the opening and closing sentences; `label-write.mjs` reads three hand-off phrases and three label-kind phrases here; `check-expected-skips.mjs` needs its own name in this file.
- 〈模板与表〉 claim template: `record-recognisers` pins the `Thread session:` line.
- The decision frame: `check:skill-frame-sync` and `check:skill-frame-freshness`.
- 〈升级与决策〉 steps ② and ③ and several 〈状态模型〉 lines: runtime messages of `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-prior-rulings.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`, `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` and `ensure-pm-labels.sh` send the reader to them by name.

In `os-dev.md` the lines other tools read (the commit-trailer rule, the decision-box rule, the `Skills-docs:` line, the dogfood trigger line, the front matter) are all untouched.

### Ratchet rows (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, data rows only)

| Row | Before | After | Note |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 33919 | 33351 | -568: the five lines (566 B) plus the 2 B of headroom |
| `references/decision-analysis.md` | 5023 | 5589 | +566, the declared cross-file move |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 38986 | 33504 | -5482 |
| `checklist-test/SKILL.md` | 19558 | 14209 | -5349 |
| `references/dev-traps.md` | none | 2627 | new row, landed size, headroom 0 |
| `references/dev-ablation.md` | none | 3555 | new row, landed size, headroom 0 |
| `checklist-test/references/closure.md` | none | 4553 | new row; table-row pin 214 B, moved with the table |
| `checklist-test/references/standing-regression.md` | none | 1261 | new row, landed size, headroom 0 |
| map total over these rows | 97486 | 98649 | +1163 |

- The one raise of an existing row is `decision-analysis.md`, taken as a same-PR cross-file move under #14685 item 5 (comment 5520452691) and declared in `CROSS_FILE_MOVES`: +566 against SKILL.md's -568. The gate prints: `cross-file move into .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md: +566 (5023→5589) against a net source decrease of 568 (.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md 33919→33351)` and `declared cross-file moves: 1, total ceilings down 2 bytes`.
- A new file cannot be the destination of a declared move (the script requires a pre-move ceiling above 0) and one source may pay only one destination, so the four new reference files get rows at their landed size, the way the platform-readings split did (commit `2013c3828`).
- The claim on the card expected total ceilings not to rise. Inside the declared move they do not (down 2 B); over the whole map they rise by 1163 B, because a pointer line and a file title cost bytes that a byte-for-byte move cannot pay without deleting rule text. **The seat accepted this rise under the step-3 ruling** (seat call, 2026-11-26 00:15Z): 98649 − 97486 = 1163 B = 771 B of pointer lines + 400 B of titles, headings and keys in the four new files − 8 B of headroom returned by lowered rows; the moved text nets 0. The alternatives were deleting rule text (breaks "no rule changes meaning") or dropping pointers (breaks the done-when).
- The +1163 B on the map is not rule text. The 12162 B of moved text leave and arrive byte for byte (net 0). What is new: six pointer lines (771 B) and the titles, section headings and one-line keys of the four new files (400 B), minus 8 B of headroom the lowered rows give back. The ruling of record that orders this text is the one on the card: the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z) to the skills review order, whose step 3 reads "Everything else moves to a reference file that is read only on the path that needs it".

## Tests

At head `eeddbb0ea`, plus the commit `f3a092b8e` re-check below.

- Verbatim proof (a scratch script, not committed): for each of the ten blocks, the lines at origin/main are found as one contiguous run in the new home; every line deleted from an entry file is a moved line; every added line is one of the six pointers. Result: 146 lines moved, 146 deleted, 6 added, no stray deletion.
- Pin scan: every phrase of every moved line `git grep -F`'d across `scripts`, `.github`, `packages`, `.claude`, `docs`, `content/docs`, `skills` and `AGENTS.md`. No script, test, hook or workflow reads a moved phrase. The hits outside the new homes are prose in other skill files that say the same thing in their own words.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 commands from the change set (at `eeddbb0ea`: 9 files, +192 / -151, 343 changed lines against the 3000 threshold). All 46 ran with the exit code captured before any pipe: 46 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `46 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 46 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- Two more, outside the derived list: `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0 and `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` exit 0 (`116 cases pass`).
- Among the 46: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` exit 0 (`133 file(s) clean`), `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` exit 0, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0 (`2313 cases pass`, 515 s).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (0 open PR heads share a file). `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0, 4 commits.
- Commit `f3a092b8e` (three stale sentences): `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, the ratchet `--self-test`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness`, the commit-trailer check (5 commits) and `overlap-check.mjs` (VERDICT clean) all exit 0; `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 37 commands for the two newly touched paths, and all 37 exit 0 (after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a build of `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` in the fresh worktree; the first pass without them exited 3, prerequisite not met).
- No ablation: the diff changes documentation and data rows, no tested behaviour. `test:repo` and the whole-root families are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Three sentences this PR's moves made stale are fixed in commit `f3a092b8e` (claim addendum on the card, seat order 00:15Z): `.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md:74` now names `pm-dispatch/references/dev-ablation.md` (9526 → 9525 B, ceiling 9526); `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs:295` is a comment, not logic, and now names `references/dev-ablation.md`, reached from `os-dev.md`; the ratchet script's header sentence on what the map covers now names the `checklist-test` references/. No logic changes.
- The declared move leaves 2 B of margin. A later ruled raise on `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` re-opens the declaration, by the script's own design; the PR that takes that raise retires the declaration with it.
- `references/instrument-discipline.md` has no ceiling row on main. Observed while reading the map; not touched.
- Out of scope, no card filed (maintainer: no new cards): about 7 KB of `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is one-path text that scripts read at that file (see "Why SKILL.md shrinks so little"). A further cut needs those blocks moved together with their script anchors. Measure first: how often a PM run takes each of those paths, against the bytes they cost on every run.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `CEILINGS` hunk, the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` entry and the four `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` rows. The risk is a row that rises with no payer.
2. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: the four pointer lines. The risk is a pointer whose condition is narrower than the block it replaces.
3. `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §5: the pointer line and the 「验证重测」 paragraph that stays.

Two-minute check: `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=no origin/main...HEAD -- .claude` shows all 146 removed lines in the moved colour and exactly 15 added lines in the plain new colour: the six pointers and the nine title, heading and key lines of the four new files. Then `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ends with `declared cross-file moves: 1, total ceilings down 2 bytes` and exit 0.
